run_express_reader: run the ExpressReader module to parse an EXPRESS schema file and extract entities and types
read_express_schema: read an EXPRESS schema file and return a Schema object with parsed entities and types
create_schema_object: create a Schema object with OrderedDicts for entities and types from an EXPRESS file
parse_entity_fields: parse EXPRESS entity definitions and extract Field objects with name, type, and optional flags
review_regex_patterns: review the compiled regex patterns re_match_entity, re_match_type, and re_match_field for EXPRESS parsing
